checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'organic-content-plan'.

checks.description: The content plan is mapped to the strategy angle and segments.
checks.rule: Body restates the angle and segments from the strategy-artifact and ties each content theme to the segment it serves, introducing no new message.

checks.description: The post calendar carries date, account, format, segment, and a copy variant ref per post.
checks.rule: Body and template define a post calendar where each post has a date inside the campaign window, an account, a format, the segment served, and a copy variant ref.

checks.description: The channel mix uses the owned accounts in scope from the brief and is not invented.
checks.rule: Body sets the channel mix from the accounts in scope in the brief and stops-and-asks when accounts, cadence, or window are absent rather than inventing them.

checks.description: One asset is repurposed into many formats; Blotato is noted as gated, not assumed live.
checks.rule: Body includes a repurposing map turning one master asset into many formats and notes Blotato video repurposing is gated and added on approval with a manual fallback until then.

checks.description: The plan references QA-passed copy variants by id; it never writes captions or publishes.
checks.rule: Body states captions are written by copywriter-ar and the English copywriter and referenced by variant id, and the plan never writes captions and never publishes.

checks.description: No invented Skill Path titles, content lineup, instructor names, offers, prices, or targets.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing a posting cadence, account, Skill Path title, content lineup, instructor name, offer, price, or target, and bars accreditation and roadmap leaks.

checks.description: A usable content plan template exists.
checks.rule: templates/organic-content-plan.md exists and contains content_plan, post_calendar, channel_mix, repurposing_map, and distribution_routing sections.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash, the U+0640 tatweel, or Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
